biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your photos/videos sell or when you win paid assignments; no guaranteed income.
catches: Free for photographers to join and use; Scoopshot takes a 25% service fee when photo buyers submit assignments
Photos/videos you submit become available for sale in the Scoopshot store; you also earn a share of in-image ad revenue when publishers use your content
Cash out to bank account or PayPal; transfers can take days to weeks depending on method
Model releases required for commercial use of photos with recognizable people
You keep copyright; Scoopshot acts as broker for rights and payments
